messages:
laura: Heads-up — Erebos on‑prem change window proposal. Customer asked for a quiet window Thu 2026-04-15 02:00–03:30 UTC to apply the runtime update + config changes. Can folks confirm availability and smoke plan? I listed preliminary steps below.

simon: I can take the deploy lead. Will be online 01:30 UTC for preflight.

marta: I’ll do post-deploy infra checks and watch metrics for 30m after cutover. Oncall Jordan will be primary pager.

raj: Quick question — are we changing the model binary or just runtime flags? If it’s binary we need an additional rollback artifact.

laura: Good call — it’s runtime + kernel selector tweaks, no model swap. But the customer asked to keep an easy rollback to previous runtime image. I uploaded the image tag references to the customer bucket.

laura: Proposed runbook (short):
1) 01:30 — preflight: verify node health, disk, KVM, cert validity.
2) 01:45 — snapshot config + docker image pull test.
3) 02:00 — maintenance window opens, drain target group traffic to test pool.
4) 02:05 — apply runtime update on canary host.
5) 02:15 — smoke tests against canary.
6) 02:25 — if green, roll remaining hosts in batches of 3 with 5m pause between batches.
7) 02:40 — post-rollout verification and metrics check.
8) 03:00 — reintroduce full traffic, 30m watch, close window at 03:30.

simon: Additions: ensure prefix KV cache persisted before drain, and toggle to bypass cache if we see latency regressions. Also keep quantization profile file handy.

marta: Smoke test commands (use these from bastion):
```
# health check (returns status/uptime)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://erebos.internal/api/health | jq .status

# basic generation smoke (sanity tokens)
curl -sS -X POST https://erebos.internal/api/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"smoke test: ping","max_tokens":8}' | jq .choices[0].text
```

marta: Expected green = health: "ok" and generation < 400ms p50 for canary. If p50 > 700ms flag rollback.

deploy-bot: Preflight checklist run queued by simon at 2026-04-15T01:35:00Z — results will post here.

raj: Rollback plan (short):
- If canary fails: revert canary to previous image tag (image tag stored at s3://redwood-erebos-artifacts/), re-run smoke, abort batch.
- If batch failure: stop rollout, revert all updated hosts to previous image, re-open traffic to preserved pool.
- If widespread failure after full rollout: DNS traffic flip to hosted fallback for 1h while we investigate.

laura: Who has the SRE runbook step-ids in the private doc? I’ll paste the minimal checklist to the customer-facing runbook after we confirm.

marta: I have it. I’ll push a condensed runbook to the Erebos secure doc (link pinned in their ticket) by EOD PST.

oncall-jordan: I’ll be the escalation lead. Pager details: +1-555-0202, will monitor Slack and pager. If I get paged, I’ll join the call: meet.google.com/erebos-deploy (scheduled).

simon: Network changes note — we need to ensure their load balancer connection timeout is 20s during drain, not the default 60s. Laura, can you confirm LB owner contact?

laura: Contact is Mark @erebos-ops (I already looped him in the customer ticket). He confirmed LB timeout change is fine.

marta: Last thing — backups: DB snapshot at 01:40 UTC, and registry snapshot of KV at 01:50 UTC. Please don’t start rollout until both complete.

laura: OK final checklist: preflight snapshots done, canary deploy + smoke, batch rollouts with 5m gaps, rollback artifacts on s3, oncall Jordan on pager, Mark (customer LB) available. If everyone +1, I’ll lock the customer window and send the calendar invite.

simon: +1

marta: +1

laura: Great — locking window and sending invites. I’ll post a short public note in #customer-updates when complete. :white_check_mark:
